partial_independent_evidence_that_DOES_s.note: The absence of curves does not leave the six affected runs unevidenced. Two independent, non-registry artifacts corroborate their final selection state.

sources.corroborates: the selected epoch and its macro Dice, independently of the registry
sources.limitation: carries no history - only the winning point

sources.corroborates: final selection state, and - via the bad counter - whether the writing harness had the D97 lag
sources.limitation: carries no per-epoch history; for the six D97-exposed runs its bad counter is one lower than the true final value

sources.corroborates: run ordering and wall-clock span; supports the pre/post D97-repair split without exception
sources.limitation: wall clock includes interruption dead time; last_resume_time is overwritten every epoch and is not a resume instant

partial_independent_evidence_that_DOES_s.net_effect: final-state integrity for all 15 runs is established by three independent sources; trajectory integrity for 6 runs is not recoverable by any means.

future_derivability_of_missing_metrics.question: could per-domain results and secondary metrics later be obtained from the frozen checkpoints on eligible development populations, under a separately approved descriptive-evaluation protocol?
preconditions_that_are_already_met: 15/15 best.pt exist and are SHA-verified against the registry
manifests/phase4_v3/val.csv exists with frozen SHA 082c80b2... and population 808
the evaluation rule is frozen: threshold 0.5, per-image Dice, unweighted mean over the four domains
the model sources are byte-identical to their frozen identities, so the checkpoints are loadable into the same architectures

metrics_that_could_be_derived.method: deterministic forward pass on VAL808, threshold 0.5, split by domain
surface distance on the same masks
metrics_that_could_be_derived.caveat: implementation-dependent; the distance implementation and the empty-mask convention would have to be frozen before the run or the values are not comparable across architectures

metrics_that_could_be_derived.method: join on the KUB category field

metrics_that_cannot_be_derived: the identity of every epoch ever written to best.pt
the true per-epoch loss trajectory for the six affected runs
any metric requiring the original training-time RNG state at an intermediate epoch

critical_scientific_caveat.statement: VAL808 is the checkpoint-selection set for all 15 runs (equal-domain macro Dice, patience 15). Any per-domain or secondary metric computed from these checkpoints on VAL808 is a DECOMPOSITION of a selection-contaminated number, not independent validation.
consequence: it may be reported as a descriptive decomposition of the recorded metric
it may NOT be reported as held-out performance
it may NOT be used to re-rank architectures or to revise any reported mean
it must not trigger re-selection of any checkpoint

additional_constraints_on_any_future_exe: requires a separate, explicitly approved descriptive-evaluation protocol; this document does not authorize it
must not read TEST (PHASE39-only) or ROUTER_HOLDOUT
must be labelled post-hoc and descriptive in any manuscript use
must be versioned and write-once, with the evaluation implementation SHA recorded
must not be run to rescue the AS-08 status - AS-08 is a training-protocol question and cannot be answered by re-scoring existing checkpoints
future_derivability_of_missing_metrics.why_it_would_not_repair_AS08: AS-08 asks whether protocol-faithful baselines were produced. Per-domain metrics from checkpoints trained under a divergent protocol are more detailed measurements of a divergent experiment. The defect is upstream of the metrics.
